messages:
maya: Heads-up — NorthSlope is asking to lock Dedicated capacity for Q3. They want a proposed commit + buffer policy by EOD. Can we put numbers together?
omar: Quick datapoint: baseline observed is ~3.2M GPU-min/month (~53k GPU-hours/month) from April traffic normalized. Forecasted growth factor 1.4 for Q3 promo.
priya: can you spell that out in nodes/GPUs? ops needs instance counts not minutes.
drew: quick convert: 53k GPU-hrs/mo -> ~1.77k GPU-hrs/day. If we use 8x A100 per node that's ~222 node-hrs/day, so ~9.25 nodes average. Add buffer for peaks.
maya: NorthSlope wants minimal overcommit. My initial thought: steady buffer 12% and a higher peak buffer (20–25%) for campaign windows.
omar: ops preference: safety band 20% sustained + separate burst credits for seasonal spikes. Also EU-West has a hard limit: only 6 pre-provisioned nodes left in that AZ without hw procurement.
capacity-bot: forecast summary (30d lookback + growth factor 1.6): p50=1.77k gpu-hrs/day, p90=2.6k gpu-hrs/day, p99=3.9k gpu-hrs/day. Estimated burst headroom needed ~120k gpu-hrs/month for 99->extra peaks.
priya: can we propose a tiered commit? base EU-West commit for SLA, and pooled US-West capacity for overflow + automatic fallback. Keeps EU quota small and reduces latency for EU customers.
maya: proposal draft: EU-West commit 150 GPUs steady (~10.8k GPU-hrs/mo), US-West pooled commit 500 GPUs, shared burst token bucket 100k GPU-hrs, buffer policy: 15% committed safety + throttle/shape at p95.
omar: networking note: last time we did cross-region fallback it saturated egress/NGW in EU-West. If we want reliable fallback we should preprovision extra NIC/backhaul capacity — cost estimate +$12k/mo.
drew: config snippet for SOW send to AMs:
```yaml
commit:
  eu-west:
    steady: 150
    safety_buffer_pct: 15
  us-west:
    pooled: 500
burst:
  token_bucket: 100000 # gpu-hours
  throttle_at_p95: true
fallback_policy: prefer-local -> us-west -> eu-central
```
maya: also include optional quantized model tier for embeddings/low-latency workloads — customers can enable quantization which we estimate reduces GPU-hrs ~30% for those workloads. Good to include as a cost-saver.
omar: operational edge cases: if eu-west sustained >90% for 6h, pre-warm eu-central nodes and migrate non-latency-critical jobs. Also add a circuit-breaker to avoid cascading cross-region egress.
priya: billing/legal note: Sales wants buffer included in committed rate but unused hours roll into credits for 90 days. Confirmable?
maya: sales OK with credits up to 3 months per account, will confirm in SOW.
capacity-bot: deploy-checklist: check quotas, file egress quota ticket, tune k8s-node-autoscaler, set circuit-breaker thresholds. linked ticket: INC-6821.
omar: filing the egress preprovision ticket now.
maya: I'll draft the SOW with: base commit (EU minimal), pooled US-West commit for throughput, 15% safety buffer on commit, 100k gpu-hr token bucket for burst, optional egress preprovision for +$12k/mo, quantized model option and 3-month roll-over credits. Will ping NorthSlope AM once draft posted.
drew: :thumbsup:
maya: thanks all — please scan SOW when I post and call out any operational gaps.
